description: Get your submission for one assignment: score, grade, submitted time, lateness and deductions, attachments and instructor comments. Read-only. Use get_submission_history for earlier attempts.

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

name: get_my_submission
title: Get My Submission
